checks: Positive/negative flat summon attack and damage modifiers append to dice formulas without evaluation; actual tabs, library and detail clicks remain usable
Summon equips main-inventory references without creating copies; quantities stay total, availability is reserved, and HP/AC/weapon formulas use summon stats
Another summon cannot reuse a one-quantity item; two copies allow two separate summons, with zero remaining availability
Main character cannot equip a weapon whose only copy is currently borrowed by a summon
Canceling an equipment draft does not release or alter a live loan
Unequipping releases the item immediately; main-character equipment occupies the copy and prevents borrowing it
Editing the original main-inventory item updates the summon live instead of leaving a stale private snapshot
Reducing inventory quantity reconciles excess reservations deterministically and removes only the unavailable equipment effects
Inventory references, reservations and equipped stats survive backup validation and actual local-storage reload
Phone equipment form fits 390px and exposes main-inventory search and all equipment slots
